_comment: Cross-collector parity golden. BOTH collector/ (Node) and collector-go/ scan corpus/ and must produce exactly these figures. Paths use forward slashes; each suite normalises its platform separator before comparing. See test-fixtures/collector-parity/README.md. schemaVersion and columns were added after issue #31: the two collectors' schemas had silently diverged (Go on 4, Node on 7), and Go's unconditional version stamp rewrote a Node-migrated database downwards, which made Node's next migrate throw on a duplicate column. toolCallSourceFiles was added for issue #32: row counts alone could not see that the Go collector left source_file_rel NULL for every tool call, so downstream resolveDispatchEvidence reported no file-touch correlation.
